create_sparse_conv: create a MinkowskiEngine sparse convolution layer using conv with specified in/out planes and kernel size
create_sparse_transpose_conv: create a MinkowskiEngine sparse transposed convolution layer using conv_tr for upsampling sparse tensor features
create_sparse_avg_pool: create a MinkowskiEngine sparse average pooling layer using avg_pool with configurable kernel size and stride
create_sparse_sum_pool: create a MinkowskiEngine sparse sum pooling layer using sum_pool to aggregate sparse tensor features
create_sparse_norm: create a MinkowskiEngine normalization layer using get_norm with BATCH_NORM or SPARSE_INSTANCE_NORM type
